t: Void-Bot Terrain: Grid Scan Desk — Simple
name: Void-Bot Terrain: Grid Scan Desk — Simple
title: Void-Bot Terrain: Grid Scan Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Terrain scans on a grid: the desk sizes the grid from the area and the sensor footprint — a 1 km² area with 10 m cells is 10,000 cells. The grid resolution is computed from the sensor, not chosen.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Cells in 1 km² at 10 m resolution = 10000 cells. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a grid that misses the features.
